title: N is for NAVIGRAPH: Real Charts & AIRAC | MSFS 2024
description:
NavData and Navigraph in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 are the missing links between "guessing" your way through a flight plan and flying perfectly synced with real-world aviation every time. In this MSFS 2024 A‑Z episode, you’ll learn why your waypoints occasionally "vanish" from the sim, how the 28-day AIRAC cycle actually works, and why flying without updated Jeppesen data can lead to major headaches during complex arrivals.

Most simmers treat their GPS like a static map—but aviation data doesn't work that way. We break down the difference between Asobo and Navigraph updates, then demo how to verify your navigation database in MSFS 2024 (and MSFS 2020) across Airbus, Boeing, and Garmin G1000/G3000 systems so you can fly instrument procedures with professional-grade precision.

✅ If this helped you sync your sim with reality, hit Like, Subscribe, and drop a comment: Which "O" topic should we cover next for the MSFS A‑Z series?
